prompt_text:
You are debugging a KAIF cluster. Clients call agentgateway at POST /v1/chat/completions. After a few successes they get HTTP 429. An AgentgatewayPolicy applies a rate limit of 3 requests per minute with burst 1 on path prefix /v1.

Respond with EXACTLY these four labeled sections and nothing else:
ROOT_CAUSE: <one sentence>
CONFIRM: <one kubectl or curl command>
FIX: <smallest durable fix in one sentence or a tiny YAML snippet>
WORKAROUND: <one sentence for a load test that must stay under the limit>

vercel-/v1.preview: ROOT_CAUSE: An AgentgatewayPolicy on the /v1 path prefix is enforcing a 3 requests/minute with burst 1 rate limit, causi
vercel-/v1.content:
ROOT_CAUSE: An AgentgatewayPolicy on the /v1 path prefix is enforcing a 3 requests/minute with burst 1 rate limit, causing 429s after the allowed requests are used.

CONFIRM: kubectl get agentgatewaypolicy -A -o yaml | sed -n '/rateLimit:/,+3p'

FIX: Apply a higher rate limit for /v1 (example YAML):
apiVersion: kaif/v1
kind: AgentgatewayPolicy
metadata:
  name: agentgateway-policy
spec:
  pathPrefix: /v1
  rateLimit:
    requestsPerMinute: 300
    burst: 50

WORKAROUND: For a load test, pace requests to at most 3 per minute (≈ one request every 20 seconds) and avoid concurrent requests to /v1 to stay under the limit.

vercel-/v1.name: vercel-/v1
vercel-/v1.preview: ROOT_CAUSE: Too-strict AgentgatewayPolicy rate limit of 3 requests per minute with burst 1 on path prefix /v1 is throttl
vercel-/v1.content:
ROOT_CAUSE: Too-strict AgentgatewayPolicy rate limit of 3 requests per minute with burst 1 on path prefix /v1 is throttling clients, causing HTTP 429 after a few successes.
CONFIRM: curl -i -X POST http://agentgateway.kaif-system.svc.cluster.local/v1/chat/completions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}'
FIX: Increase the AgentgatewayPolicy rate limit to match expected load (e.g., update the policy to 300 requests/minute with burst 20) by updating the policy spec.
WORKAROUND: Run your load test at or below 3 requests per minute (e.g., one request every 20 seconds) and avoid concurrent bursts beyond 1.

cursor-/cursor.content:
I'll inspect the workspace for the AgentgatewayPolicy and rate-limit config so the four sections match this cluster.ROOT_CAUSE: Clients exceed the AgentgatewayPolicy limit of 3 req/min (burst 1) on path prefix `/v1`, so later `/v1/chat/completions` calls are rejected with HTTP 429.
CONFIRM: `kubectl get agentgatewaypolicy -A -o yaml | grep -A20 -i ratelimit`
FIX: Raise the policy’s rate (and/or burst) for `/v1`, e.g. `rate: 60` / `burst: 10`, and apply the updated AgentgatewayPolicy.
WORKAROUND: Pace the load test to at most 3 requests per minute (e.g. one call every ~20s) so you stay under the limit.

cursor-/cursor.content:
I'll check the workspace for the AgentgatewayPolicy and rate-limit config so the four sections match this cluster.ROOT_CAUSE: The AgentgatewayPolicy’s 3 req/min limit with burst 1 on path prefix `/v1` is rejecting excess `POST /v1/chat/completions` calls with HTTP 429.
CONFIRM: `kubectl get agentgatewaypolicy -A -o yaml | grep -A20 -i ratelimit`
FIX: Raise or remove the `/v1` rateLimit in the AgentgatewayPolicy (e.g. `requestsPerUnit: 60`, `unit: minute`, `burst: 10`).
WORKAROUND: Cap the load test to at most 3 requests per rolling minute (and avoid bursts above 1).

notes: Cursor bridge often reports usage tokens as 0; tok_per_s may use len(content)/4 estimate.
Vercel /v1 may be rate-limited (e.g. 3/min) by agentgateway policy — delay between runs.
Paths are not identical models: gpt-5-mini vs Cursor auto/agent harness — compare carefully.
Cursor path includes CLI + agent harness overhead on top of model latency.
problem prompt quality_score is a lightweight structure+keyword rubric, not human eval.
